project: AI Data Transformation Assistant - fictional policy migration demo

transformation_rules.rule: Use STG_POLICY.START_DATE, extracted from SRC_POLICY.POLICY_START_DT; normalize through TO_DATE(TO_CHAR(date, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), 'YYYY-MM-DD').

Use STG_POLICY.REQUESTED_START_DATE (from SRC_POLICY.REQUESTED_EFFECTIVE_DT) when non-null; otherwise use STG_POLICY.START_DATE + 30 days (from SRC_POLICY.POLICY_START_DT). Normalize through TO_DATE/TO_CHAR.
Use STG_POLICY.START_DATE, extracted from SRC_POLICY.POLICY_START_DT; normalize through TO_DATE/TO_CHAR.

transformation_rules.note: POLICY_STATUS is a conditional dependency. EFFECTIVE_DATE is not always equal to POLICY_START_DT. SRC_POLICY_ARCHIVE.POLICY_START_DT is a deliberate decoy and has no lineage to the target.

lineage_steps.operation: PKG_POLICY_EXTRACT.LOAD_SOURCE_TO_STAGE INSERT ... SELECT; conditional date normalization
PKG_POLICY_TRANSFORM.BUILD_TRANSFORMED_ROWS CASE WHEN with NVL fallback and date normalization
lineage_steps.condition: ACTIVE and other statuses use START_DATE; PENDING uses NVL(REQUESTED_START_DATE, START_DATE + 30)
Matched rows update; unmatched rows insert

additional_target_columns.rule: Direct value projection; renamed from POLICY_ID to POLICY_NO.
Direct value projection. Also controls the EFFECTIVE_DATE CASE expression.
Obtained through SRC_POLICY.CUSTOMER_ID = SRC_CUSTOMER.CUSTOMER_ID JOIN; NVL substitutes UNKNOWN CUSTOMER.
Obtained through SRC_POLICY.PRODUCT_CODE = SRC_PRODUCT.PRODUCT_CODE JOIN; NVL substitutes UNKNOWN PRODUCT.
